name: Examples
author: Reflexive Entertainment
description: Not fun to play. This level set is intended to show level designers how to use various features of the level editor.

Value.Text: None of the levels in this Examples set are designed to be PLAYED
They are designed to be studied by level designers using the level editor.
Each level demonstrates a different scripting plug-in or editor feature.
Study them all to learn many ways to make levels.
You are allowed to copy or change anything in any of these
levels and use any parts in levels of your own.
Some levels display messages, like this one, to explain the level.
Most levels have hidden messages that can only be seen in the
level editor when you hover your cursor over the bricks.

Dynamic Properties.Comment: This is an example of a hidden comment that explains how a level works
